findings.message: The received file has the required 1536x1024 landscape canvas, no alpha channel, exactly three separated studies, no characters, no story action, and no generated labels or dialogue.

The core manga finish remains acceptable: open white surfaces, selective dark shapes, flatter lighting, matte bounded puddles without mirrored architecture, localized roof detail, and clear tonal separation are preserved.
Repeated arched windows, tiled wall bands, iron columns, roof structure, clocks, and the Cafe Siete grille continue to establish one coherent station across all three views.

The requested clock correction did not occur. The large ticket-hall clock still reads about 12:05 because the minute hand points to numeral I. It must point between I and II, visibly past I, for the locked 12:07 time.

The true-grayscale requirement regressed. The PNG is encoded as RGB with non-identical channels: mean RGB is approximately 152.41, 151.74, and 150.64, with maximum red-blue difference 21, producing a subtle warm tint.

No v006 image job or ChatGPT handoff was released. The file is accepted as an author-submitted manual retry for review, but its exact external prompt and attachment use cannot be independently verified from the PNG.
No image was edited, filtered, regenerated, converted, renamed, or promoted during review. Byte-identical copies are retained only as review evidence and targeted correction input.
